mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a labor market weakening signal, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 3.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through expanded corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 50th percentile, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) creates market uncertainty, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged tightness.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite the combination, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a tightening monetary policy regime (FEDFUNDS >4.5%), sustained rate hikes reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as risk premium increases.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in the industrial production index below 105 signals weak supply-side growth, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate slower economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO falling below 105, or the effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1) coupled with weakening labor market conditions (PAYEMS) creates conflicting signals, but the positive demand outlook dominates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 is high and PAYEMS is low, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by rising CPIAUCSL and GDPC1, investors anticipate an imminent peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to market overvaluation concerns.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative in >60% of late-cycle instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
